This edge runs FROM a blind row of family 'integer-absolute-value' TO a train row, and it did not exist until the commit that closed the evaluation recorded in artifacts/autogenesis/holdout-evaluation-v1.json as record 'holdout-evaluation-1', whose protocol_commit is a strict git ancestor of it. A scored row's proof cites the training set; that is what scoring against a training set means, and it is not blindness leaking out. The blind endpoint is written as the committed baseline's salted SHA-256 digest, never as a fact id: this artifact is inside check-autogenesis-holdout-isolation.py's scan set, and the class is keyed to the evaluation record so that every clause is a claim about a committed artifact and the commit graph rather than a judgement about a row. class_complaint re-derives all four clauses -- family and scored membership from the live manifests and the record, the preregistration order from git, and the DIRECTION: an edge INTO a blind row can never carry this class.

Re-derived by `class_complaint` in scripts/check-partition-edges.py from the live manifests; an amendment claiming it for a non-longitudinal target is reported and NOT honoured. classes.scored-evaluation-residue: The edge is the RESIDUE of a scored evaluation (ADR-1566). Honoured only when `class_complaint` in scripts/check-partition-edges.py re-derives all four clauses: (d) the amendment names `evaluation_record`, the record_id of a record in artifacts/autogenesis/holdout-evaluation-v1.json -- never a fact id; (a) the edge's blind endpoint belongs to that record's family AND appears in its outcomes, read from the live manifests and the record; (b) the record's state is `scored` and its protocol_commit is a STRICT git ancestor of the commit that introduced this edge; (c) the edge runs FROM the blind row TO a non-blind one. An edge INTO a blind row, an edge from a blind row the record does not score, and an edge older than the preregistration each remain leaks and are refused here.

endpoint_representation: An endpoint in a BLIND partition is written as the salted SHA-256 digest recorded in artifacts/autogenesis/partition-edge-baseline-v1.json (`held_out_salt`), never as the fact id -- this artifact is inside scripts/check-autogenesis-holdout-isolation.py's scan set. `edge_is_amended` compares a live edge in both the plain and the redacted representation, and `ClassContext.resolve` inverts the digest through the live manifests, which is what lets a class be re-derived from an endpoint no reader of this file can name.
not_the_baseline: The 198 crossings that existed on 2026-09-02 were recorded in artifacts/autogenesis/partition-edge-baseline-v1.json and are the re-partition's to repair (ADR-1546 option 1). An amendment is for an edge somebody DECIDED to keep; the baseline is for an edge nobody has repaired yet. Do not move a row from one to the other to make a gate green -- the one class that has moved, `depends-on-longitudinal-bootstrap` (ADR-1563, 45 edges, baseline 198 -> 153), moved because the checker RE-DERIVES the property from the live manifests rather than reading a label, and because --record-baseline now excludes an honoured amendment, so deleting one makes its edge a violation again.
rule: An amendment names ONE EDGE and nothing else. Required fields: `from` (the fact whose depends_on carries the edge), `to` (the dependency it names), `reason`, `date`. Optional: `authority`. An element missing any required field is REPORTED AND NOT HONOURED -- a malformed amendment is a committed defect and reading it as absent is how an exemption list stops being reviewable.
why_not_a_component: ADR-1546 measured a component-shaped exemption re-scoped 228 -> 230 -> 258 -> 274 members in four days against a live component of 305, because a component grows whenever any member gains an edge. A fact-id SET says nothing about which edge was reviewed, so honouring one suppresses crossings nobody looked at. This gate refuses to read `cross_population_component_split_exemptions` (or `component_split_exemptions`) as an amendment and says so in its report; those entries keep whatever meaning they have for `check-autogenesis-nursery.py`, whose unit IS the component.
